content: Yenibɑn biru ye yɑ koorɑ wee. Durɔ ɡoo u wɑ̃ɑ Yisirɛɛliɔ, win yĩsirɑ Nɑbɔti. U resɛm ɡbɑɑru mɔ, Akɑbu Sɑmɑrin sunɔn sinɑ kpɑɑrun bɔkuɔ.

Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Akɑbu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn wunɛn resɛm ɡbɑɑ te derio tu ko nɛn sɑɑdiɛ̃. Domi tɑ wɑ̃ɑ nɛn sinɑ kpɑɑrun bɔkuɔ. Kpɑ n nun resɛm ɡbɑɑru ɡɑru kɔsire kuɑ tèn resɛm yɑ yeni ɡeɑ kere. Ǹ n mɑɑ ɡobin nɑ ɑ kĩ, kon nun yi wɛ̃ nɡe mɛ ɡbɑɑ ten ɡeerɑ nɛ.
Adɑmɑ Nɑbɔti u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ u mɑn bere n kɑ nɛn tubi suɑ n nun wɛ̃, ye nɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ mɑn deriɑ.
Mɑ Akɑbu u ɡɔsirɑ yɛnuɔ kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu u mɔruɑ Nɑbɔti Yisirɛɛliɡiin ɡɑri yin sɔ̃. U dɑ u kpunɑ u kɔ̃ruɑ, u yinɑ u di.
Yerɑ win kurɔ Yesɑbɛli u nɑ win mi, u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ wunɛn nukurɑ kɑ sɑnkire sere ɑ kpɑnɑ ɑ di.
U nun wisɑ u nɛɛ, Nɑbɔtiwɑ nɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, u mɑn win resɛm ɡbɑɑru derio. Kpɑ n nùn ten ɡobi kɔsiɑ, ǹ kun mɛ, n nùn ɡɑru kɔsire kuɑ. Adɑmɑ u nɛɛ, u ǹ mɑn tu wɛ̃ɛmɔ.
Yerɑ Yesɑbɛli wi, u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n ǹ wunɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ? A seewo ɑ di kɑ nuku dobu. Nɛ, kon nun Nɑbɔtin ɡbɑɑ te wɛ̃.
Yerɑ u ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ siri kowobu be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ wuu teu kɑ Nɑbɔti tirenu yoruɑ kɑ Akɑbun yĩsiru u Akɑbun yĩreru doke tire ni sɔɔ.
Ye u yoruɑ wee. U nɛɛ, i kpɑro i bɑɑwure sɔ̃ u nɔɔ bɔke kpɑ i de tɔmbu bu mɛnnɑ kpɑ i Nɑbɔti ɡbiisiɑ ben wuswɑɑɔ.
Kpɑ i tɔn kɔ̃sobu yiru ɡɑbu wunɑ bu nɑ win wuswɑɑɔ bu nùn tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ bɑ n mɔ̀, wiyɑ u Gusunɔ kɑ sinɑ boko bɔ̃rusi. Yen biru i nùn yɑro i kɑ dɑ wuun biruɔ i kpenu kɑsuku i ɡo.
Mɑ Nɑbɔtin wuun ɡuro ɡuro be, kɑ ben siri kowo be, bɑ kuɑ nɡe mɛ Yesɑbɛli u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ tire ni sɔɔ.
Bɑ nɔɔ bɔku te kuɑ wuu ɡiru bɑ mɑɑ Nɑbɔti ɡbiisiɑ tɔmbun wuswɑɑɔ.
Mɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu yiru ye, bɑ nɑ bɑ sinɑ win wuswɑɑɔ. Bɑ tɔn wɔru ɡe sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Nɑbɔti u Gusunɔ kɑ sinɑ boko bɔ̃rusi. Mɑ bɑ nùn ɡɑwɑ bɑ kɑ yɑrɑ wuun biruɔ bɑ kpenu kɑsukɑ bɑ ɡo.
Mɑ wuun wiruɡii be, bɑ Yesɑbɛli sɔmɔ ɡɔriɑ bɑ nɛɛ, bɑ Nɑbɔti kpee ni kɑsukɑ bɑ ɡo.
Sɑɑ ye Yesɑbɛli u nuɑ mɑ bɑ Nɑbɔti ɡo, yerɑ u dɑ u Akɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ resɛm ɡbɑɑ te suɑ te Nɑbɔti Yisirɛɛliɡii u rɑɑ yinɑ u nun dɔre mi, domi u ɡu.
Ye Akɑbu u nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ u dɑ u ɡbɑɑ te suɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ
u Akɑbu kɑ Yesɑbɛli tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃
Sɑɑ yerɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Eli Tisibiɡii sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ seewo ɑ dɑ ɑ kɑ Akɑbu Isirelibɑn sinɑ boko yinnɑ wi u wɑ̃ɑ Sɑmɑriɔ. Wi wee, u wɑ̃ɑ Nɑbɔtin resɛm ɡbɑɑrɔ u kɑ tu suɑ.
A nùn sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Ye u tɔnu ɡo u kpɑ, yerɑ u koo mɑɑ yɛ̃ron tubi suɑ? Tɛ̃ mi bɔ̃nu nu Nɑbɔtin yɛm dɑburɑ, miyɑ nu koo mɑɑ win tiiɡim dɑbiri.

Yerɑ Eli u dɑ Akɑbun mi. Ye u turɑ mi, yerɑ Akɑbu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn yibɛrɛ, ɑ den mɑn wɑ? Eli u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nun wɑ. Wee, Yinni Gusunɔ u koo nun kɔ̃sɑ suremɑ kpɑ u wunɛn tɔmbu kpuro ɡo kɑ wunɛn yobɔ yèn sɔ̃ ɑ tii yɔ̃su ɑ kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ win wuswɑɑɔ.
U koo de wunɛn yɛnu ɡu ko nɡe Yeroboɑmu Nɛbɑtin biiɡuu, ǹ ku mɛ, nɡe Bɑsɑ Akiyɑn biiɡuu. Domi ɑ win mɔru seeyɑ, mɑ ɑ Isirelibɑ doke torɑru sɔɔ.
Wee ye Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ ɡeruɑ Yesɑbɛlin sɔ̃. U nɛɛ, bɔ̃nɑ nu koo win ɡoru tem Yisirɛɛlin ɡbɑ̃rɑrun bɔkuɔ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ Akɑbuɡibu sɔɔ, wi u ɡu yɛnuɔ, bɔ̃nɑ nu koo yɛ̃ron ɡoru tem. Wi u mɑɑ ɡu yɑkɑsɔ, ɡunɔsɑ su koo yɛ̃ron ɡoru di.
Domi ɡoo sɑri wi u tii yɔ̃su kɔ̃sɑ sɔɔ nɡe Akɑbu, Yinni Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ. N deemɑ win kurɔ Yesɑbɛliwɑ u rɑ n nùn dɑm kɛ̃mɔ u kɑ ye ko.
U kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ ye yɑ ǹ kɑ nɔɔ ɡerurɔ. Domi u dɑ u bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ nɡe Amɔrebɑ be Gusunɔ u ɡirɑ. Mɑ u ben tem Isirelibɑ wɛ̃.
Akɑbu u win durum
tuubɑ kuɑ
Ye Akɑbu u Elin ɡɑri yi nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ u tii kɑwɑ u win yɑbe ni u sebuɑ nɛnuɑ u ɡɛ̃ɛkɑ mɑ u sɑɑki suɑ u tii tɛ̃kusi, u nɔɔ bɔkuɑ. Sɑɑki yerɑ, u rɑ kɑ bɔsu kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu. Yerɑ u rɑ mɑm kɑ kpunɛ.
Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ Eli Tisibiɡii wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ wɑ nɡe mɛ Akɑbu u tii kɑwɑ nɛn wuswɑɑɔ? Yen sɔ̃, nɑ ǹ mɑɑ derimɔ kɔ̃sɑ ye, yu koorɑ win wɑɑti sɔɔ. Win biin wɑɑti sɔɔrɑ kon de yu koorɑ.
